shots.speaker: NARRATOR
shots.text:
The KRAP van cut east through the rain.
Inside, Captain Vasile finally opened the file.

shots.speaker: CAPTAIN VASILE
shots.text:
Welcome to Acaristan, Biribel.
Hope you enjoyed the scenery.

shots.speaker: CAPTAIN VASILE
shots.text:
Sebastian Volkov. IPA affiliate.
We've been tracking him for six months.
Tonight he's making a handoff in the slum district.

shots.speaker: CAPTAIN VASILE
shots.text:
Your job: get in, capture him alive, get out.
He knows names. We want those names.

shots.speaker: CAPTAIN VASILE
shots.text:
He won't get far.
But if he does, bring back anything he leaves behind.
Paper, drives, a notebook - anything.

shots.speaker: CAPTAIN VASILE
shots.text:
Here. Standard sidearm.
Keep it holstered until you have no choice.

shots.speaker: CAPTAIN VASILE
shots.text:
And take these: two molotovs.
Ugly tools, but they clear alleys fast.

shots.speaker: CAPTAIN VASILE
shots.text:
Comms on channel 4. Don't die.
I hate paperwork.
